title: This Ant Blows Itself Up to Save Its Colony

scenes.text: This ant blows itself up to save its colony.
It lives high in the treetops of Borneo, and it's called the exploding ant.
When a bigger ant attacks, the tiny workers bite it and squeeze.
Their bodies burst open and spray a sticky, toxic yellow goo that smells a bit like curry.
The attacker is stuck. The colony is safe. The worker doesn't survive.
An ant that explodes on purpose. Watch it again.

description:
Some ants in Borneo literally explode to protect their colony.
The exploding ant, Colobopsis explodens, bursts its own body to coat attackers in sticky, toxic goo that smells like curry.
Would you give everything for your team like this ant?
first_comment: Bonus: the exploding ant was the first new exploding species described since 1935. Which animal would you least want to bother?
